concepts.name: AccountsPayable
concepts.definition: IFRS trade & other current payables.

concepts.name: AccountsPayableAndAccrued
concepts.definition: Combined accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

concepts.name: AccountsPayableChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: accounts payable change.

concepts.name: AccountsReceivable
concepts.definition: IFRS trade & other current receivables.

concepts.name: AccountsReceivableChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: accounts receivable change.

concepts.name: AccrualsChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: accrued liabilities change.

concepts.name: AccruedExpenses
concepts.definition: Accrued liabilities (salaries, interest, utilities).

concepts.name: AccumulatedAmortization
concepts.definition: Accumulated amortization on finite-lived intangible assets. IntangibleAssetsNet = IntangibleAssetsGross - this.

concepts.name: AccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.definition: Total accumulated depreciation on PP&E.

concepts.name: Acquisitions
concepts.definition: Cash paid for business acquisitions (M&A).

concepts.name: AdditionalPaidInCapital
concepts.definition: Excess of issue price over par value on equity issuances.

concepts.name: AdjustedFundsFromOperations
concepts.definition:
AFFO = FFO − recurring CapEx − straight-line rent adjustments.
Closer to free-cash-flow-per-share than FFO.

concepts.name: AllowanceForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.definition: Reserve against uncollectible receivables.

concepts.name: AntidilutiveShares
concepts.definition: Shares excluded from diluted EPS as antidilutive.

concepts.name: AOCI
concepts.definition: Accumulated other comprehensive income/loss balance.

concepts.name: AssetRetirementObligation
concepts.definition: Asset retirement obligation liability (ASC 410) — present value of legally-required asset decommissioning, restoration, or environmental remediation costs.

concepts.name: AvailableForSaleSecurities
concepts.definition:
Securities classified as available-for-sale (AFS) under ASC 320
— neither held-to-maturity nor trading.  Carried at fair value
with unrealized gains/losses in OCI.

concepts.name: BadDebtProvision
concepts.definition: Credit loss provision (CF add-back).

concepts.name: CAPEX
concepts.definition: IFRS capital expenditure — PP&E purchases.

concepts.name: CapitalizedSoftwareCosts
concepts.definition:
Capitalized internally developed software. Amortized over the
expected useful life (typically 3–5 years).

concepts.name: CashAndEquivalents
concepts.definition:
Cash, demand deposits, and highly liquid investments with original
maturities ≤ 90 days.  Includes restricted cash variants disclosed
by ASC 230 (US GAAP) and IAS 7 (IFRS) — both treated identically
here since restricted balances still belong on the balance sheet
and are not separable in cross-sectional analysis.

concepts.name: ClaimsAndBenefits
concepts.definition:
Claims paid + change in claim reserves + policyholder benefits.
The largest expense line for most insurers; drives the loss ratio.

concepts.name: ClinicalTrialCosts
concepts.definition:
Costs incurred running clinical trials. Not always disclosed as a
separate line — often embedded in R&D. When broken out,
reveals development-stage focus.

concepts.name: CombinedRatio
concepts.definition:
Loss ratio + expense ratio. Below 100 % = underwriting profit;
above = underwriting loss. The single most-watched P&C metric.

concepts.name: CommonSharesAuthorized
concepts.definition: Maximum shares authorized per corporate charter.

concepts.name: CommonSharesIssued
concepts.definition: Total common shares issued (including treasury).

concepts.name: CommonSharesOutstanding
concepts.definition: Common shares currently outstanding (issued minus treasury).

concepts.name: CommonStockIssuance
CommonStockParValue
concepts.definition: Par or stated value per common share.

concepts.name: CommonStockValue
concepts.definition: IFRS issued share capital — analogous to GAAP CommonStockValue.

concepts.name: ComprehensiveIncome
concepts.definition: Net income + OCI.  Total change in equity from non-owner sources.

concepts.name: ComprehensiveIncomeNCI
concepts.definition: Comprehensive income attributable to non-controlling interests.

concepts.name: ContingentConsiderationChange
concepts.definition: Fair-value re-measurement of earnout / contingent consideration.

concepts.name: ContractAssets
concepts.definition:
ASC 606 contract assets — earned but unbilled revenue. Common in
multi-year SaaS contracts billed annually but recognized monthly.

concepts.name: CostOfRevenue
concepts.definition: IFRS cost of sales — equivalent to GAAP CostOfRevenue.

concepts.name: CurrentAssets
concepts.definition: IFRS current assets.

concepts.name: CurrentIncomeTaxExpense
concepts.definition:
Aggregated current-period income tax expense (federal + state +
foreign).  Distinct from the deferred-tax component, which moves
through DeferredTaxExpense.  Companies that report only an
aggregated figure surface here; per-jurisdiction filers expose
CurrentTaxFederal / CurrentTaxState / CurrentTaxForeign.

concepts.name: CurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: IFRS current liabilities.

concepts.name: CurrentPortionLTD
concepts.definition: Long-term debt maturing within 12 months.

concepts.name: CurrentTaxFederal
concepts.definition: Federal/national current income tax.

concepts.name: CurrentTaxForeign
concepts.definition: Foreign jurisdiction current income tax.

concepts.name: CurrentTaxState
concepts.definition: State and local current income tax.

concepts.name: DebtIssuance
concepts.definition: IFRS debt issuance cash inflow.

concepts.name: DebtIssuanceCosts
concepts.definition: Fees and costs paid for issuing debt.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityThereafter
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due after year 5.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityY1
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due within 12 months.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityY2
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due in year 2.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityY3
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due in year 3.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityY4
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due in year 4.

concepts.name: DebtMaturityY5
concepts.definition: Long-term debt principal repayments due in year 5.

concepts.name: DebtRepayment
concepts.definition: IFRS debt repayment cash outflow.

concepts.name: DeferredAcquisitionCosts
concepts.definition:
Capitalized policy acquisition costs (commissions, underwriting)
amortized over the policy life. Asset on the BS under GAAP.

concepts.name: DeferredFinanceCostsNet
concepts.definition:
Unamortized debt-issuance costs presented as a contra-liability to
long-term debt (ASU 2015-03).  Material for issuers with frequent
debt refinancings.

concepts.name: DeferredRevenueChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: deferred revenue change.

concepts.name: DeferredRevenueCurrent
concepts.definition: Contract liabilities / deferred revenue (current).

concepts.name: DeferredRevenueNoncurrent
concepts.definition: Long-term deferred revenue / contract liabilities.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssetsGross
concepts.definition:
Total deferred tax assets before valuation allowance.  Pair with
DeferredTaxValuationAllowance to get DeferredTaxAssetsNet.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssetsLiabNet
concepts.definition:
Net deferred tax position (DTA − DTL) reported as a single line.
Most filers post-ASU 2015-17 net everything to noncurrent; legacy
current vs. noncurrent split aliases are folded in here.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssetsNet
concepts.definition: Net deferred tax assets.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssetsNOL
concepts.definition: DTA from net operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxAssetsOther
concepts.definition: Deferred tax assets from sources not separately disclosed.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxExpense
concepts.definition: Deferred income tax provision from timing differences.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxLiabilities
concepts.definition:
Total deferred tax liabilities (gross), before netting against
deferred tax assets.  Net version is DeferredTaxLiabNoncurrent.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOther
concepts.definition: Deferred tax liabilities from sources not separately disclosed.

concepts.name: DeferredTaxLiabNoncurrent
concepts.definition: Deferred tax liabilities (non-current).

concepts.name: DeferredTaxNonCash
concepts.definition: Non-cash deferred tax provision (CF add-back).

concepts.name: DeferredTaxValuationAllowance
concepts.definition: Valuation allowance against deferred tax assets.

concepts.name: DefinedContributionCost
concepts.definition: 401(k) and other defined contribution plan expense.

concepts.name: DepletionExpense
concepts.definition:
Period write-down of natural-resource asset basis based on units
extracted. Energy/mining specific cousin of depreciation.

concepts.name: Deposits
concepts.definition:
Customer deposits (checking, savings, time deposits, money market).
Largest liability on most bank balance sheets and the cheapest
funding source.

concepts.name: DepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.definition: IFRS D&A expense.

concepts.name: DerivativeAssets
concepts.definition: Fair value of derivative instruments held as assets.

concepts.name: DerivativeLiabilities
concepts.definition: Fair value of derivative instruments held as liabilities.

concepts.name: DiscontinuedOpsIncome
concepts.definition: Net income from discontinued business segments.

concepts.name: Divestitures
concepts.definition:
Cash received from divesting businesses or subsidiaries.  Mirror of
Acquisitions; together they bracket net M&A activity (the
``net_ma_activity`` field in get_capital_allocation_profile).

concepts.name: DividendPerShare
concepts.definition: IFRS dividends per ordinary share.

concepts.name: Dividends
concepts.definition: Cash dividends paid to shareholders.

concepts.name: DueToRelatedParties
concepts.definition: Amounts owed to related parties.

concepts.name: EffectiveTaxRate
concepts.definition: Effective income tax rate.

concepts.name: EffectOfExchangeRateOnCash
concepts.definition: Currency translation impact on cash position.

concepts.name: EPSBasic
concepts.definition: Basic earnings per share (US-GAAP + IFRS).

concepts.name: EPSBasicAndDiluted
concepts.definition: Combined basic and diluted EPS (equal when no dilutive securities).

concepts.name: EPSContinuingOpsBasic
concepts.definition: Basic EPS from continuing operations.

concepts.name: EPSContinuingOpsDiluted
concepts.definition: Diluted EPS from continuing operations.

concepts.name: EPSDiluted
concepts.definition: Diluted earnings per share — most conservative, standard for valuation (US-GAAP + IFRS).

concepts.name: EPSDiscontinuedOps
concepts.definition: EPS from discontinued operations.

concepts.name: EquityIssuance
concepts.definition: Cash from issuing common shares (IPO, secondary, option exercises).

concepts.name: EquityMethodIncome
concepts.definition: Share of income from unconsolidated affiliates (20-50% ownership).

concepts.name: EquityMethodInvestments
concepts.definition: Equity method investees (20-50% ownership stakes).

concepts.name: ExcessTaxBenefitFromSBC
concepts.definition: Tax benefit realised on SBC in excess of grant-date expense.

concepts.name: ExplorationCosts
concepts.definition:
Cost of exploring for new oil/gas/mineral reserves. Often
written off in the period (successful efforts vs full cost
accounting choice matters here).

concepts.name: ExplorationExpense
concepts.definition: Exploration costs for extractive industries (oil/gas, mining).

concepts.name: FederalFundsPurchased
concepts.definition: Overnight borrowings of reserves from other banks.

concepts.name: FederalFundsSold
concepts.definition: Overnight loans of excess reserves to other banks.

concepts.name: FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances
concepts.definition: Wholesale funding from FHLB system.

concepts.name: FederalIncomeTax
concepts.definition: US Federal income tax expense/benefit (current + deferred).

concepts.name: FeesAndCommissions
concepts.definition: Fee income from deposit accounts, cards, advisory, custody.

concepts.name: FinancingCashFlow
concepts.definition: IFRS financing cash flows.

concepts.name: ForeignCurrencyGainLoss
concepts.definition: FX translation and transaction gains/losses.

concepts.name: ForeignIncomeTax
concepts.definition: Foreign income tax expense/benefit.

concepts.name: FundsFromOperations
concepts.definition:
NAREIT FFO: Net income + Real estate D&A − Gains on property sales.
The standard REIT earnings proxy. AFFO subtracts recurring CapEx
to approximate distributable cash.

concepts.name: FXEffectOnCash
concepts.definition: Foreign exchange rate impact on cash balances.

concepts.name: GainLossOnAssetSale
concepts.definition: Gains/losses on asset dispositions and debt extinguishments.

concepts.name: GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.definition: Realized and unrealized gains/losses on investment securities.

concepts.name: GeneralAndAdmin
concepts.definition: G&A — corporate overhead, management, office costs.

concepts.name: Goodwill
concepts.definition: IFRS goodwill.

concepts.name: GoodwillAcquired
concepts.definition:
Goodwill recognized during the period from business combinations.
A direct signal of M&A activity; complements the existing
Acquisitions cash-outflow canonical.

concepts.name: GrossProfit
concepts.definition: IFRS gross profit — revenue minus cost of sales.

concepts.name: ImpairmentCharges
concepts.definition: Asset write-downs to fair value (goodwill, intangibles, PP&E).

concepts.name: IncomeContinuingOps
concepts.definition: Net income from continuing operations.

concepts.name: IncomeTaxExpense
concepts.definition: IFRS income tax expense.

concepts.name: IncrementalDilutiveShares
concepts.definition: Additional shares from dilutive securities (options, RSUs, convertibles).

concepts.name: InProcessRD
concepts.definition:
In-process research & development acquired in M&A. Charged off
at acquisition under US GAAP if abandoned; otherwise capitalized.

concepts.name: InsuranceCommissions
concepts.definition: Commission income for insurance agencies and brokerages.

concepts.name: InsurancePremiums
concepts.definition:
Premiums earned during the period. The core revenue line for any
insurance carrier; net of premiums ceded to reinsurers.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationThereafter
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles after year 5.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationY1
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles in the next 12 months.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationY2
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles in year 2.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationY3
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles in year 3.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationY4
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles in year 4.

concepts.name: IntangibleAmortizationY5
concepts.definition: Expected amortization expense for finite-lived intangibles in year 5.

concepts.name: IntangibleAssetsGross
concepts.definition: Intangible assets at historical cost.

concepts.name: IntangibleAssetsNet
concepts.definition: Intangible assets (patents, trademarks, etc.) net of amortization.

concepts.name: IntangiblesPurchase
concepts.definition: Cash spent on intangible assets (patents, software, licenses).

concepts.name: InterestExpense
concepts.definition: Cost of debt financing.  Bloomberg: IS_INT_EXPENSE.

concepts.name: InterestExpenseBank
concepts.definition: Interest paid on deposits, borrowings, FHLB advances. Bank-specific.

concepts.name: InterestExpenseNet
concepts.definition: Net interest expense (interest expense minus interest income).

concepts.name: InterestIncome
concepts.definition: Interest and dividend income from investments.

concepts.name: InterestIncomeBank
concepts.definition: Interest earned on loans and investment securities. Bank-specific.

concepts.name: InterestPaidCash
concepts.definition: Cash interest paid (supplemental disclosure).

concepts.name: InterestPayable
concepts.definition: Accrued interest on debt not yet paid.

concepts.name: InterestPayableChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: interest payable change.

concepts.name: Inventory
concepts.definition: IFRS inventories.

concepts.name: InventoryChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: inventory change.

concepts.name: InventoryFinishedGoods
concepts.definition: Finished goods inventory (ready for sale).

concepts.name: InventoryRawMaterials
concepts.definition: Raw material inventory (unprocessed inputs).

concepts.name: InventoryWIP
concepts.definition: Work-in-process inventory (partially completed).

concepts.name: InvestingCashFlow
concepts.definition: IFRS investing cash flows.

concepts.name: InvestmentsPurchase
concepts.definition: Cash used to purchase investment securities.

concepts.name: InvestmentsSale
concepts.definition: Proceeds from selling/maturing investment securities.

concepts.name: LaborExpense
concepts.definition: IFRS wages & salaries — maps to LaborExpense bucket.

concepts.name: LineOfCreditMax
concepts.definition:
Maximum (committed) borrowing capacity under all revolving credit
facilities.  Standard credit-strength metric; the drawn portion
sits in ShortTermDebt or LongTermDebt depending on maturity.

concepts.name: LoanLossAllowance
concepts.definition:
Reserve held against probable / expected loan losses. CECL under
US GAAP, ECL under IFRS 9. Contra-asset against gross loans.

concepts.name: LoansReceivable
concepts.definition:
Gross loans and leases held for investment, before allowance for
credit losses. Largest asset on most bank balance sheets.

concepts.name: LongTermDebt
concepts.definition:
Long-term debt due after 12 months, before unamortized discount or
deferred financing costs.  Excludes lease obligations (use
OperatingLeaseLiabNoncurrent) and current maturities (use
CurrentPortionLTD).

concepts.name: LongTermInvestments
concepts.definition: Non-current investment securities.

concepts.name: LossRatio
concepts.definition:
Claims paid / premiums earned. Sub-100 % means underwriting
profitability before expenses. Industry benchmark for P&C.

concepts.name: MilestonePaymentsRevenue
concepts.definition:
Upfront / milestone / royalty payments under licensing or
collaboration agreements (often with big-pharma partners).

concepts.name: MinorityDistributions
concepts.definition: Dividends/distributions paid to non-controlling interest holders.

concepts.name: MinorityInterest
concepts.definition: IFRS non-controlling (minority) interests in equity.

concepts.name: NetChangeInCash
concepts.definition: IFRS net change in cash for the period.

concepts.name: NetChargeOffs
concepts.definition:
Loans written off during the period minus recoveries on previously
charged-off loans. Realized credit losses; flow-side complement to
ProvisionForLoanLosses.

concepts.name: NetIncome
concepts.definition: IFRS profit/loss for the period.  Strict prevents OCI contamination.

concepts.name: NetIncomeNCI
concepts.definition: IFRS profit/loss attributable to non-controlling interests.

concepts.name: NetIncomeToCommon
concepts.definition: IFRS profit/loss attributable to parent-company owners.

concepts.name: NetInterestIncome
concepts.definition:
Total interest income on loans and investments minus interest
expense on deposits and borrowings. Bank equivalent of gross
profit — the core of bank profitability.

concepts.name: NetOperatingIncome
concepts.definition:
Property rental revenue − property operating expenses (excludes
D&A, interest, G&A). Same-store NOI growth is the canonical REIT
operational metric.

concepts.name: NetPeriodicBenefitCost
concepts.definition: Pension / OPEB net periodic benefit cost (per ASC 715).

concepts.name: NonInterestExpense
concepts.definition:
Operating expenses unrelated to interest cost (compensation,
occupancy, technology, regulatory). Drives the bank efficiency
ratio (NonInterestExpense / (NetInterestIncome + NonInterestIncome)).

concepts.name: NonInterestIncome
concepts.definition:
Fee income, trading revenue, advisory, brokerage commissions
— bank revenue that does not derive from net interest spread.

concepts.name: NonperformingLoans
concepts.definition:
Loans 90+ days past due or on non-accrual status. NPL ratio
(NPL / total loans) is the canonical asset-quality metric.

concepts.name: NotesPayableCurrent
concepts.definition:
Short-term notes payable (typically < 12 months).  Distinct from
accounts payable — these are formal promissory notes.

concepts.name: NumberOfEmployees
concepts.definition: Total full-time equivalent employees.

concepts.name: NumberOfSegments
concepts.definition: Number of reportable operating segments.

concepts.name: OccupancyRate
concepts.definition: Percentage of total rentable square footage currently leased.

concepts.name: OCICashFlowHedges
concepts.definition: OCI — effective portion of cash flow hedge gains/losses.

concepts.name: OCIForeignCurrency
concepts.definition: OCI — foreign currency translation adjustments.

concepts.name: OCIPensions
concepts.definition: OCI — pension and postretirement benefit plan adjustments.

concepts.name: OCISecurities
concepts.definition: OCI — unrealized gains/losses on available-for-sale securities.

concepts.name: OilProduction
concepts.definition: Crude oil produced during the period.

concepts.name: OperatingCashFlow
concepts.definition: IFRS operating cash flows.

concepts.name: OperatingExpenses
concepts.definition: Total operating expenses (SGA + R&D + D&A + other operating).

concepts.name: OperatingIncome
concepts.definition: IFRS operating profit.  Not mandated; not all IFRS filers report this.

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseCashPayments
concepts.definition: Cash paid for operating lease liabilities.

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseImputedInterest
concepts.definition: Imputed interest discount on undiscounted lease payments.

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseLiabCurrent
concepts.definition: IFRS current lease liability (IFRS 16).

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseLiabNoncurrent
concepts.definition: IFRS non-current lease liability (IFRS 16).

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseLiabTotal
concepts.definition: Total operating lease liability.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsDue
concepts.definition: Total undiscounted future operating lease payments.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsThereafter
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due after year 5.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsY1
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due within 12 months.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsY2
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due in year 2.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsY3
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due in year 3.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsY4
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due in year 4.

concepts.name: OperatingLeasePaymentsY5
concepts.definition: Operating lease payments due in year 5.

concepts.name: OperatingLeaseWADiscountRate
concepts.definition: Weighted average discount rate for operating leases.

concepts.name: OtherAssets
concepts.definition:
Single ``Other Assets`` line item — neither current nor non-current
splits.  Used by issuers that report a flat ``Other Assets`` total.
For the explicitly-current and explicitly-non-current variants use
OtherCurrentAssets / OtherNoncurrentAssets.

concepts.name: OtherComprehensiveIncome
concepts.definition: Total OCI net of tax.

concepts.name: OtherCurrentAssets
concepts.definition: Current assets not classified elsewhere.

concepts.name: OtherCurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: Current liabilities not classified elsewhere.

concepts.name: OtherIncome
concepts.definition:
Single ``Other Income'' line — issuer-disclosed bucket for
non-operating income items not otherwise classified.  Use
OtherNonOperating for the netted version.

concepts.name: OtherLiabilities
concepts.definition:
Single ``Other Liabilities`` line — used by issuers that don't
split current vs non-current.  See OtherCurrentLiabilities /
OtherNoncurrentLiabilities for the split variants.

concepts.name: OtherNonCashCharges
concepts.definition: Other non-cash adjustments to net income.

concepts.name: OtherNoncurrentAssets
concepts.definition: Non-current assets not classified elsewhere.

concepts.name: OtherNoncurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: Non-current liabilities not classified elsewhere.

concepts.name: OtherNonOperating
concepts.definition: Miscellaneous non-operating income/expense.

concepts.name: OtherOperatingExpense
concepts.definition: Miscellaneous operating expenses not classified elsewhere.

concepts.name: OtherRevenue
concepts.definition: Revenue not classified in primary categories.

concepts.name: PatentsCarryingValue
concepts.definition: Net carrying value of acquired or licensed patents.

concepts.name: PensionLiabilities
concepts.definition: Defined benefit pension and postretirement obligations.

concepts.name: PensionPlanFundedStatus
concepts.definition: Pension plan assets minus PBO (funded status).

concepts.name: PolicyAcquisitionCosts
concepts.definition:
Cost of writing new policies (commissions, underwriting). May be
capitalized as Deferred Acquisition Costs and amortized.

concepts.name: PolicyLiabilities
concepts.definition:
Total policy reserves — future obligations to policyholders for
claims, annuities, and policy benefits. Usually the largest
insurance liability.

concepts.name: PPEGross
concepts.definition: PP&E at historical cost before accumulated depreciation.

concepts.name: PPENet
concepts.definition: IFRS net PP&E.

concepts.name: PPESale
concepts.definition: Proceeds from selling PP&E or productive assets.

concepts.name: PreferredSharesOutstanding
concepts.definition: Preferred shares outstanding / issued / authorized.

concepts.name: PreferredStockParValue
concepts.definition: Par or stated value per preferred share.

concepts.name: PreferredStockValue
concepts.definition: Total value of preferred shares issued.

concepts.name: PrepaidExpenses
concepts.definition: Advance payments for future expenses.

concepts.name: PrepaidExpensesChange
concepts.definition: Working capital: prepaid expense change.

concepts.name: PretaxIncome
concepts.definition: Earnings before income taxes (EBT).  Bloomberg: IS_INC_BEF_TAX.

concepts.name: ProfessionalFees
concepts.definition: Legal, audit, consulting, and professional service costs.

concepts.name: ProjectedBenefitObligation
concepts.definition: Pension / OPEB projected benefit obligation.

concepts.name: ProvedGasReserves
concepts.definition: Estimated economically recoverable natural gas reserves.

concepts.name: ProvedOilReserves
concepts.definition:
Estimated quantities of oil that can be economically recovered
under current conditions. Reserve life (reserves / annual
production) is a core upstream operator metric.

concepts.name: ProvisionForLoanLosses
concepts.definition:
Charge to income for expected loan losses (CECL under US GAAP /
ECL under IFRS 9). Negative impact on earnings; movement in
LoanLossAllowance.

concepts.name: ReclassificationFromAOCI
concepts.definition: Amounts reclassified out of AOCI into net income this period.

concepts.name: ReinsuranceRecoverable
concepts.definition:
Estimated amounts recoverable from reinsurers for ceded losses.
Important credit exposure to reinsurer counterparties.

concepts.name: RemainingPerformanceObligation
concepts.definition:
ASC 606 disclosure: total transaction price for unsatisfied
performance obligations. Closest GAAP-disclosed proxy for
contracted backlog / forward revenue (often bigger than ARR for
enterprise SaaS).

concepts.name: RentAndOccupancy
concepts.definition: Lease, rent, and occupancy expense.

concepts.name: ResearchAndDevelopment
concepts.definition: R&D expense — forward-looking innovation investment indicator.

concepts.name: RestrictedCashChange
concepts.definition: Period change in restricted cash — reconciling item in CF statement.

concepts.name: RestructuringCharges
concepts.definition: One-time reorganization, layoff, and facility closure costs.

concepts.name: RestructuringReserve
concepts.definition:
Liability for future restructuring costs (severance, lease exit,
contract termination) accrued under ASC 420 / IAS 37.  Movement
feeds the income statement RestructuringCharges line.

concepts.name: RetainedEarnings
concepts.definition: IFRS retained earnings.

concepts.name: RevenueDomestic
concepts.definition: Revenue from the issuer's home country.

concepts.name: RevenueInternational
concepts.definition: Revenue from markets outside the issuer's home country.

concepts.name: RightOfUseAssetFinance
concepts.definition: Finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.name: RightOfUseAssetOperating
concepts.definition: Operating lease right-of-use asset (ASC 842).

concepts.name: ROUAssetForNewLeases
concepts.definition: Non-cash: ROU assets obtained for new operating lease liabilities.

concepts.name: SBCDilutiveAdjustment
concepts.definition:
Adjustment to weighted-average diluted shares for option / RSU /
warrant dilution.  Equals WeightedAvgSharesDiluted minus
WeightedAvgSharesBasic.

concepts.name: SBCOptionsExercisable

concepts.name: SBCOptionsOutstanding
concepts.definition: Stock options currently outstanding.

concepts.name: SBCOptionsVestedAndExpectedToVestCount
concepts.definition: Number of options vested + expected to vest (outstanding-weighted).

concepts.name: SBCOptionsVestedAndExpectedToVestIntrinsicValue

concepts.name: SBCRSUsOutstanding
concepts.definition: Restricted stock units (RSUs) currently outstanding.

concepts.name: SBCRSUsVested
concepts.definition: RSUs vested during the period.

concepts.name: SBCTaxBenefit
concepts.definition: Income tax benefit from equity compensation.

concepts.name: SBCTaxWithholding
concepts.definition: Tax withholding payments related to equity award settlement.

concepts.name: SBCUnrecognizedCost
concepts.definition: Remaining unrecognized SBC expense for unvested awards.

concepts.name: SegmentRevenue
concepts.definition: Revenue / operating profit by reportable segment.

concepts.name: SellingAndMarketing
concepts.definition: Sales, marketing, and advertising costs.

concepts.name: SellingGeneralAdmin
concepts.definition: SG&A — combined selling, general and administrative overhead.

concepts.name: SeparateAccountAssets
concepts.definition:
Assets held in separate accounts on behalf of variable annuity /
universal life policyholders. Off-balance-sheet for credit risk
but on-balance-sheet under GAAP/IFRS.

concepts.name: ShareBuyback
concepts.definition: Cash spent repurchasing company shares.

concepts.name: ShareRepurchaseAuthorized
concepts.definition: Board-authorized share repurchase program amount.

concepts.name: ShortTermDebt
concepts.definition: IFRS short-term borrowings.

concepts.name: ShortTermInvestments
concepts.definition: Marketable securities and short-term investment holdings.

concepts.name: StateAndLocalIncomeTax
concepts.definition: State and local income tax expense/benefit.

concepts.name: StatutoryTaxRate
concepts.definition: Statutory federal income tax rate from the rate-reconciliation footnote (21% post-TCJA, 35% pre-2018). Distinct from the realized EffectiveTaxRate.

concepts.name: StockBasedCompensation
concepts.definition: IFRS share-based payment adjustment in the operating cash-flow reconciliation.

concepts.name: StockholdersEquity
concepts.definition: Parent-only stockholders' equity (excludes non-controlling interest).

concepts.name: StockholdersEquityIncludingNCI
concepts.definition: Total stockholders' equity including non-controlling interest — institutional total book value.

concepts.name: StockOptionExercise
concepts.definition:
Cash received from employees exercising stock options.  Separate
from non-cash equity issuance disclosures.

concepts.name: SubscriptionRevenue
concepts.definition:
Recurring revenue from SaaS subscriptions. Not a standardized
XBRL tag — companies disclose under various extensions; mostly
reachable through the cost-of-revenue product/service split.

concepts.name: TaxesPaidCash
concepts.definition: Cash income taxes paid (supplemental disclosure).

concepts.name: TaxPayable
concepts.definition: Current income taxes owed to tax authorities.

concepts.name: TemporaryEquity
concepts.definition: Mezzanine/temporary equity — redeemable equity between debt and equity.

concepts.name: TierOneCapitalRatio
concepts.definition:
Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets. Basel III
regulatory minimum for well-capitalized banks is 8 %. Below 6 %
triggers prompt corrective action.

concepts.name: TotalAssets
concepts.definition: IFRS total assets.

concepts.name: TotalCostsAndExpenses
concepts.definition: Total costs and expenses before non-operating items.

concepts.name: TotalCurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: Total current liabilities.

concepts.name: TotalDebt
concepts.definition: Total interest-bearing debt obligations.

concepts.name: TotalLiabilities
concepts.definition: IFRS total liabilities.  IFRS 16 may inflate vs GAAP ASC 842.

concepts.name: TotalLiabilitiesAndEquity
concepts.definition: Must equal Total Assets (accounting identity).

concepts.name: TotalNoncurrentAssets
concepts.definition:
Sum of non-current (long-term) assets.  Reciprocal of CurrentAssets;
together they sum to TotalAssets.  Reported directly by some
issuers (us-gaap:AssetsNoncurrent) and derivable as TotalAssets −
CurrentAssets when not reported.

concepts.name: TotalNoncurrentLiabilities
concepts.definition: Total non-current liabilities.

concepts.name: TotalRevenue
concepts.definition: IFRS top-line revenue.  IFRS 15 / ASC 606 converged.

concepts.name: TotalRiskBasedCapitalRatio
concepts.definition:
Total regulatory capital (Tier 1 + Tier 2) divided by
risk-weighted assets. Basel III minimum is 10.5 % for
well-capitalized banks.

concepts.name: TradingRevenue
concepts.definition: Realized + unrealized gains/losses from trading book activity.

concepts.name: TreasuryShares
concepts.definition: Number of common shares held in treasury.

concepts.name: TreasuryStock
concepts.definition: Cost of repurchased shares held in treasury (contra-equity).

concepts.name: UnearnedPremiums
concepts.definition:
Premiums collected for coverage not yet provided — the deferred
revenue analog for P&C insurers. Earned over the policy period.

concepts.name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefits
concepts.definition: Uncertain tax positions that could result in future obligations.

concepts.name: WeightedAverageCommonShares
concepts.definition: IFRS weighted-average shares outstanding (basic).

concepts.name: WeightedAvgSharesBasic
concepts.definition: Weighted average basic shares outstanding.

concepts.name: WeightedAvgSharesDiluted
concepts.definition: Weighted average diluted shares outstanding.

ttm_note: The `ratio` table holds BOTH annual (`fiscal_period = 'FY'`, `is_ttm = false`) and trailing-twelve-month (`fiscal_period = 'TTM'`, `is_ttm = true`) rows per company. TTM is the sum/normalization of the latest four reported quarters, dated at the entity's most recent quarter close, so it is the most-current read; FY rows are dated at fiscal-year close. TTM rows exist ONLY for the profitability, per_share, liquidity, efficiency, and leverage categories — forensic, growth (CAGR), and sector-percentile ranks are annual-only. Always filter on a single period (e.g. `WHERE is_ttm = FALSE`, or `WHERE fiscal_period = 'FY'`); a raw `read_table('ratio')` query that does NOT filter `is_ttm` / `fiscal_period` returns FY + TTM rows for the same metric and DOUBLE-COUNTS companies in a screen. The SDK SQL templates already filter by a single fiscal_period, so they are safe — this warning is for raw DuckDB queries.
